confirmed_task: Using only the visible Python documentation interface, use the site search to search for pathlib Path.write_text newline, submit the search, open the relevant pathlib documentation result, and navigate to the Path.write_text entry. Report what Path.write_text returns and the Python version in which its newline parameter was added. You must perform the search, result opening, and documentation navigation through the UI; do not answer from prior knowledge.

items.criterion: Use the Python docs site search for the specified query
items.description: Using only the visible Python documentation UI on docs.python.org, locate the site search box and execute a search for "pathlib Path.write_text newline" (or an equivalent query clearly targeting Path.write_text and its newline parameter). Full credit if the agent attempts this via the UI but is blocked by external issues (site down/CAPTCHA/search widget not loading) and clearly reports the issue and at least one reasonable retry (e.g., refresh, alternate browser UI element, or navigating to the search page). Partial credit if a weaker query is used but still plausibly targets the correct entry.

items.criterion: Open a relevant pathlib search result
items.description: From the search results, open a relevant official Python documentation result leading to pathlib documentation where Path.write_text is documented. Full credit if the agent selects a reasonable result but cannot open it due to external issues (broken link, site down) and reports this while trying another relevant result. Partial credit if the agent opens general pathlib docs but not the most relevant result when a clearly relevant one is available.

items.criterion: Navigate to the Path.write_text entry within the documentation page
items.description: Within the opened pathlib documentation page, navigate (e.g., table of contents, in-page search, scrolling to the anchor) to the specific Path.write_text entry/section. Full credit if the agent reaches the Path.write_text section; also full credit if page navigation is impeded by external/UI issues (page not fully loading, broken anchors) and the agent demonstrates reasonable alternate attempts (e.g., using in-page find, TOC, or switching to a different relevant docs page/version) and clearly reports the blocker.

State the return value of Path.write_text exactly as described in the Path.write_text documentation entry reached via the UI. Full credit for an accurate return description; partial credit for a directionally correct but incomplete description. If the agent cannot access the entry due to external blockers after reasonable attempts, it should explicitly say it could not verify the return value from the UI (do not guess) and can receive full credit for this criterion only if the blocker is well-documented in the attempt.

items.criterion: Report the Python version in which the newline parameter was added
items.description: Report the exact Python version indicated in the Path.write_text documentation (e.g., via a versionadded note) for when the newline parameter was added. Full credit for the correct version tied to the documentation note. Partial credit if a version is reported but the connection to the docs note is unclear. If the agent cannot access the entry due to external blockers after reasonable attempts, it should explicitly say it could not verify the version from the UI (do not guess) and can receive full credit for this criterion only if the blocker is well-documented in the attempt.
